verdict.rationale: Decagon is a SaaS customer-support AI platform, so a documented public API for driving it is a fair question. The evidence never mentions such an API, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. The cited material covers outbound integrations (JWT-scoped access to customer systems, MCP tooling, Browser Actions) and no-code configuration via AOPs and Duet, none of which is an inbound API for controlling Decagon.
